newsitem.title: CANADA: Scott Paper says Kruger amends offer.
newsitem.headline: Scott Paper says Kruger amends offer.

text.p: Scott Paper Ltd said on Tuesday that Kruger Inc has amended its plan of arrangement with a subsidiary of Kimberly-Clark Corp for the purchase of all Scott shares to pay minority shareholders C$23 in cash for each share of Scott.

Kimberly-Clark Worldwide Inc currently owns 50.1 percent of Scott Paper's common shares and originally agreed to an offer from Kruger to purchase all shares for C$15.50 in cash and C$7.50 principal amount of 10-year 10-percent senior subordinated notes.
Scott said Kimberly-Clark intends to vote its shares in favor of the amended offer.

"The terms of the proposed plan of arrangement were amended as a result of discussions with a number of shareholders who expressed a strong preference for all cash consideration," said David Erskine, President and Chief Executive Officer of Scott Paper. "We believe that this all cash offer will be enthusiastically approved by our shareholders."
Scott said that in order to give shareholders to consider and respond to the revised plan, its annual meeting has been rescheduled to June 3, 1997 from May 22, 1997.
Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday that it rated Scott Paper Ltd PIK subordinated notes at B (high) with a stable trend.
